title: Hardship Waiver Share by Age of the Named Posting - Ostomy Supply Program
content:
**Financial counseling guidance - Ostomy Supply Program.** The age of the posting an Ostomy Supply Program hardship application names adds an age share to the share that multiplies the capped waiver base. Age is measured in calendar days from the named posting's posting date to the date the application was received.

| Age of the named posting | Share added |
|---|---|
| More than 180 days | 10% (the long-age share) |
| More than 120 and at most 180 days | 5% (the mid-age share) |
| 120 days or fewer | Nothing |

The age share is added to the share that multiplies the capped waiver base.

**Boundaries (hypothetical).** A posting 120 days old when the application is received adds nothing; at 121 days it adds 5%; at 180 days still 5%; at 181 days 10%.
